name: Paddle shift NA/Euro characteristic (CAN Setup byte 156)
module_notes: MES groups this under its 'Body' control module, not TCM or ESM. Not present in cuore/live/did_catalog.py; no DID reverse-engineered yet.

write_target.did_note: No ISO 14229 DID documented by any source; 'byte 156' is MES's internal PROXI-dataset index only. Do not treat as a confirmed DID.

prerequisites: Interface connected to OBD port, correct make/model/version selected, Connect (F10)
Back up current PROXI/config data to a text file before editing (community best practice, not vendor-documented)
Edit only bits 4-5 of byte 156; leave remaining bits untouched
Run PROXI ALIGNMENT PROCEDURE (F10) and confirm (Y) after the byte edit
Turn ignition key to OFF after successful PROXI alignment, per official manual's generic closing step
verification: Confirm both-paddles-pull reaches Neutral and right paddle returns to Drive (EU behaviour)
Re-scan all modules for new DTCs after the change
risks: No documented DID; write is to a vendor-internal byte inferred from one forum post
Adjacent bits in the same byte/config area reported to affect unrelated settings if mis-edited
reversal_method: Restore backed-up byte value and re-run PROXI ALIGNMENT PROCEDURE
